newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Denway falls on bigger interim loss.
newsitem.headline: Denway falls on bigger interim loss.

text.p: Shares of Denway Investment Ltd fell on Thursday after the company reported a bigger than expected interim loss, brokers said.
The stock fell HHK$0.03, or 7.31 percent, to a morning low of HK$0.38 on volume of 1.09 million shares.

"It is not surprising to see investors unload their stakes as its earnings are seen in a downtrend, especially since its car production has been reduced compared with past years," a sales director at a regional brokerage said.
Denway posted a HK$75.76 million loss for the first half of 1996, compared with a HK$58.48 million loss a year ago.
